member.summary: Searches and lists breweries with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
member.remarks: Results can be filtered by search text, brewery name, or city. Page size is limited to 200. Distance sorting requires both latitude and longitude.

Token used to cancel the request when the client disconnects.
member.returns: A page of matching breweries and pagination metadata.

member.summary: Returns autocomplete suggestions for brewery names matching a term.
member.remarks: The term must contain at least two characters; the limit must be between 1 and 20.
member.param: Required text used to find matching brewery names.
Token used to cancel the request when the client disconnects.
Maximum number of suggestions to return; defaults to 10.
member.returns: A list of matching brewery-name suggestions.
